entities.summary: Brandon Pirri is a Canadian former professional ice hockey centre. He was selected by the Chicago Blackhawks in the second round of the 2009 NHL Entry Draft. Pirri also played for the Florida Panthers, Anaheim Ducks, and Vegas Golden Knights.
